title: El gallo pinto
desc: You are fed before anybody asks your name
setting: You have been inside doña Carmen's house four minutes and there is already a plate on the table.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.en: Sit down then. Do you eat egg?

options.en: Thank you, doña. I eat everything.
options.feedback: Como de todo is the answer that makes you easy to feed, and being easy to feed is most of it.
Correct and small. She was offering more than an egg.
In this house that is not about food. Nobody lets a person leave without eating, and refusing is refusing her.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Aquí tiene. Gallo pinto, cuajada y tortilla.
steps.en: Here you are. Gallo pinto, cuajada and tortilla.

options.en: That looks good. Is this the cuajada?
options.feedback: You praised the plate and asked about the one thing you did not know. Both go down well at a table like this.
Polite. A word about the food itself is worth more here than the thanks.
Asking for something else at somebody's table reads as a complaint, whatever your tone was.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.en: Shall I serve you some more?

options.es: Un poco más, doña. Está muy rico.
options.en: A little more, doña. It is very good.
options.feedback: A second plate is the compliment. Taking a little and saying why is better than taking a lot in silence.

options.en: No, thank you. I am full.
options.feedback: Allowed, and she will ask twice more. Saying you are full is the polite version of no.

options.en: I do not want any more.
options.feedback: Flat refusal with nothing softening it. Ya no quiero is for a child who has had enough.

options.es: De los Estados Unidos, doña. Pero aquí estoy muy bien.
options.en: From the United States, doña. But I am very happy here.
options.feedback: She waited until you had eaten to ask who you are. Answering warmly is how you tell her the meal worked.
Correct. It is an answer rather than a conversation, and she was starting one.
It sounds like you would rather not say. She asked because she is interested, not because she is checking.
